question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Succinct
solution:
The correct answer is: **Lengthy**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Succinct **means brief and to the point. (संक्षिप्त)

 
 
• **Example**: *The professor gave a succinct explanation of the complex theory.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Lengthy **means involving or requiring a considerable amount of time, often characterized by being long and detailed. (लंबाई)
 
 
• **Example**: *The meeting became lengthy as each participant shared their opinions.*
 
 
 
• So, the antonym for Succint is Lengthy.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Empty**: Containing nothing; having no contents. (खाली)
 
• **Hasty**: Done or acting with excessive speed or urgency, often without proper consideration. (उतावला)
 
• **Hearty**: Warm, enthusiastic, and sincere; expressing genuine warmth or friendliness. (हार्दिक)
